name: Hang glider
definition: unpowered, foot-launched glider with a rigid frame under a fabric wing, steered by the pilot's weight shift.

name: Paraglider
definition: unpowered, foot-launched glider with a flexible ram-air fabric wing hung on suspension lines; a powered paraglider is G1.

name: Free-flight harness
definition: harness that suspends and carries the pilot under a hang glider or paraglider.

name: Traction kite
definition: steerable kite made to pull a rider on land (on a buggy, board or skis) or to train for kite sports.

name: Parachute
definition: canopy, container and harness system for descending from an aircraft, skydiving rigs included (K-96).

name: Ballet shoe
definition: soft, flexible slipper made for ballet practice and performance.

name: Pointe shoe
definition: ballet shoe with a stiffened box and shank for dancing on the tips of the toes.

name: Tap shoe
definition: dance shoe with metal plates at toe and heel that sound the steps.

name: Dance practice wear
definition: garment made for the demands of dance practice and not suited to everyday wear; E2 only if the P1 test holds, otherwise A1.

name: Hurdle
definition: barrier on a base that athletes clear in hurdle races, height-adjustable to the race standard.

name: Starting block
definition: pair of angled foot plates fixed to the track that sprinters push off at the start.

name: Starting pistol
definition: blank-firing pistol made to start races; one made for self-defence or deterrence is E4 (P15).

name: Track spike
definition: lightweight running shoe with a spike plate made for track competition.

name: Climbing harness
definition: sit harness with leg loops and belay loop that ties the climber into the rope; the UIAA or EN standard is `standard_met`.

name: Climbing helmet
definition: helmet made for climbing and mountaineering against falling objects and falls, certified to the UIAA or EN climbing-helmet standard.

name: Climbing rope
definition: dynamic or static kernmantle rope made for climbing, rated to UIAA 101 or its EN equivalent.

name: Climbing shoe
definition: tight-fitting shoe with a sticky rubber sole and rand made for climbing rock or walls.

name: Compass
definition: magnetic compass made for navigation on foot (baseplate, thumb or sighting compass); a drawing compass is C5 (C6-O2).

name: Map case
definition: waterproof transparent case that holds a map for use outdoors.

name: Airsoft marker
definition: replica gun that fires plastic BB pellets by spring, gas or electric power, made for airsoft play; energy limits go to the jurisdiction ledger (C17).

name: Paintball hopper
definition: feed container mounted on a paintball marker that holds the paintballs and feeds them to it.

name: Paintball marker
definition: compressed-gas gun that fires paint-filled balls, made for paintball play.

name: Paintball mask
definition: full-face mask with a goggle lens made to protect the eyes and face from paintballs or airsoft pellets.

name: Boxing glove
definition: padded glove worn for boxing sparring, bagwork or competition.

name: Foil
definition: light thrusting fencing weapon with a flexible rectangular blade, made to FIE rules for the foil.

name: Epee
definition: thrusting fencing weapon with a stiff triangular blade and a large bell guard, made to FIE rules for the epee.

name: Sabre (fencing)
definition: cutting and thrusting fencing weapon with a knuckle guard, made to FIE rules for the sabre; the sabre sword is E4 (homonym, C9).

name: Fencing mask
definition: mesh mask with a bib that protects a fencer's face, head and neck; the FIE 1600 N bib is `standard_met`.

name: Fencing jacket
definition: protective jacket made for fencing, rated to a puncture resistance such as FIE 800 N.

name: Judo uniform (judogi)
definition: heavy cotton jacket and trousers made for judo grips and throws; level provisional until attested in two regions (R-19).

name: Bokken
definition: solid wooden sword made for kendo and other Japanese sword-art practice.

name: Kendo armour
definition: protective armour set made for kendo (head guard, gloves, breastplate and waist guard).

name: Shinai
definition: practice sword of bamboo or carbon staves made for kendo sparring.

name: Wushu practice weapon
definition: blunt or unsharpened wushu implement (sword, broadsword, staff, spear) made for practice or competition (K-87).

name: HEMA training sword
definition: blunt steel or synthetic sword made for HEMA sparring and drills (section 14, provisional).

name: HEMA fencing jacket
definition: padded jacket made for HEMA, rated to a puncture resistance such as 350 N or 800 N, recorded as `standard_met` (section 14, provisional).

name: HEMA protective gloves
definition: padded or plated gloves that protect the hands from sword blows in HEMA sparring (section 14, provisional).

name: Cycling shoe
definition: stiff-soled shoe made for cycling, usually with a cleat interface for clipless pedals (cleat systems are C13 rows).

name: Padded cycling shorts
definition: close-fitting shorts with a sewn-in chamois pad made for riding a bicycle.

name: Riding hat
definition: helmet made for horse riding, certified to an equestrian helmet standard (K-125).

name: Fishing rod
definition: flexible rod made to cast and play a fish on a line; power and action are attributes.

name: Decoy
definition: model or replica of a bird or animal set out to lure game within range (K-163).

name: Game call
definition: device blown, struck or played electronically that imitates an animal's sound to attract game (K-163).

name: Game trap
definition: snare, leg-hold or body-grip trap made for trapping game or fur animals; mouse, rat, insect and live-catch cage traps are B8.4 (R-6; level provisional, R-19).

name: Hunting blind
definition: portable hide or screen that conceals a hunter from game (K-163).

name: Hunting rangefinder
definition: handheld laser rangefinder made to measure the distance to game (K-148).

name: Speargun
definition: underwater gun powered by rubber bands or compressed air that fires a spear at fish.

name: Archery target
definition: boss, butt or block made to stop arrows, with or without a target face (K-163).

name: Arm guard
definition: guard strapped to the bow arm that protects it from the bowstring (K-163).

name: Finger tab
definition: leather or synthetic pad worn on the drawing fingers to hold and release the string (K-163).

name: Boomerang
definition: curved throwing wing made to return to the thrower or fly for distance, in every form (K-84).

name: Clay target
definition: frangible disc thrown as a flying target for clay shooting.

name: Clay thrower
definition: hand or machine trap that launches clay targets.

name: Cue
definition: tapered stick used to strike the balls in pool, snooker and billiards.

name: Pool table
definition: cloth-covered slate or board table with cushions, with or without pockets, made for pool, snooker or billiards.

name: Dartboard
definition: target board made for darts, of bristle, cork or electronic segments.

name: Driver
definition: lowest-lofted wood with the largest head, made to hit the ball off the tee for maximum distance.

name: Fairway wood
definition: wood with more loft and a smaller head than the driver, made to be hit from the fairway or tee.

name: Hybrid (utility)
definition: club with a compact wood-like head that replaces a long iron.

name: Iron set
definition: matched set of irons of graded loft with flat-faced heads; iron category (game improvement, players distance, blade) is an attribute.

name: Wedge
definition: high-lofted club made for short approach, pitch, chip and bunker shots.

name: Putter
definition: low-lofted club made to roll the ball on the green.

name: Golf ball
definition: dimpled ball made to the rules of golf.

name: Golf rangefinder
definition: handheld laser rangefinder made to measure the distance to the flag; golf GPS units are D2 (K-148).

name: Upright exercise bike
definition: stationary pedal machine with an upright seat and handlebar, the canonical exercise bike; resistance type is the attribute `resistance_type` (section 14 E2-1; the memo's "exercise bike").

name: Spin bike (indoor cycling bike)
definition: stationary bike with a heavy front flywheel and a road-bike riding position that allows riding out of the saddle (section 14 E2-1, provisional).

name: Recumbent exercise bike
definition: stationary bike with a seat with a backrest and the pedals set forward (section 14 E2-1, provisional).

name: Fitness trampoline
definition: small trampoline (rebounder) with a frame of about 1.2 m or less, sold for exercise; a garden or play trampoline is E1 (K-159, cut provisional).

name: Rowing machine
definition: stationary machine that simulates rowing with a sliding seat and a resisted pull handle.

name: Treadmill
definition: machine with a moving belt for walking or running in place; motorised or manual drive is an attribute (C10).

name: Kettlebell
definition: cast weight shaped as a ball with a handle, swung and lifted in training.

name: Weight bar
definition: bar made to carry weight plates for lifting (barbell or dumbbell bar).

name: Yoga mat
definition: thin, non-slip mat made for yoga and floor exercise.

name: Metal detector
definition: handheld search coil and control unit made to find buried metal objects for treasure hunting.

name: Pinpointer
definition: small handheld probe detector that locates a find inside a dug hole.

name: Digging tool
definition: trowel, spade or knife made to dig out finds in metal detecting.

name: Bivvy bag
definition: waterproof, breathable sleeping-bag cover used as a minimal shelter.

name: Sleeping bag
definition: insulated bag to sleep in outdoors; season or temperature rating is an attribute.

name: Sleeping mat
definition: foam, self-inflating or air pad that insulates and cushions a sleeper from the ground.

name: Tarp shelter
definition: waterproof sheet pitched with poles or lines as a roof shelter.

name: Tent
definition: portable fabric shelter pitched on poles or frames, yurts and tipis included (K-65); a platform built for it is G2.

name: Trekking pole
definition: adjustable walking pole used for support on trails; grip type (I-type, T-type, Nordic) is an attribute.

name: Badminton racket
definition: light, long-shafted racket strung for badminton; balance, U-weight and flex are attributes.

name: Shuttlecock
definition: feathered or plastic-skirted projectile hit in badminton.

name: Table-tennis bat
definition: wooden blade, with or without rubbers, used to hit the ball in table tennis; grip (shakehand, penholder) is an attribute.

name: Table-tennis table
definition: regulation-surface table with a net made for table tennis; indoor or outdoor is an attribute (C12).

name: Tennis ball
definition: felt-covered rubber ball made for tennis; pressurised or pressureless is an attribute.

name: Tennis racket
definition: strung racket made for tennis; head size, weight and balance are attributes.

name: Tennis shoe
definition: court shoe sold as a performance model with a court-specific sole for tennis; an everyday tennis-lineage sneaker is A2 (K-127).

name: Padel racket
definition: solid, stringless perforated racket made for padel (section 14 E2-2, provisional).

name: Padel ball
definition: pressurised felt ball made for padel, slightly less pressurised than a tennis ball (section 14 E2-2, provisional).

name: Pickleball paddle
definition: solid, flat-faced paddle made for pickleball (section 14 E2-2, provisional).

name: Pickleball ball
definition: perforated plastic ball made for pickleball (section 14 E2-2, provisional).

name: Inline skate
definition: boot with a single line of wheels in a frame, made for skating.

name: Kick scooter
definition: unpowered scooter with a deck and handlebar, pushed along by foot; a powered kick scooter is G1.

name: Skateboard
definition: unpowered board on two trucks and four wheels, ridden standing; a powered board is G1.

name: Unicycle
definition: unpowered single-wheel cycle pedalled and balanced by the rider; an electric unicycle is G1 (K-90).

name: Ski goggles
definition: goggles made for skiing and snowboarding against glare, wind and snow (K-125).

name: Ski helmet
definition: helmet made for skiing and snowboarding (K-125).

name: Alpine ski
definition: ski made for downhill skiing with a fixed-heel binding; use class, width and radius are attributes.

name: Ski boot
definition: rigid plastic-shell boot made to drive an alpine or touring ski through the binding; flex index on the maker's scale is an attribute.

name: Cross-country ski
definition: long, narrow ski made for Nordic touring or racing with a free-heel binding.

name: Ice skate
definition: boot with a steel blade made for skating on ice.

name: Touring ski
definition: light ski made for climbing with skins and descending, used with a touring binding and boot interface (E-16).

name: Sledge
definition: unpowered sled or toboggan ridden downhill on snow or ice for play or sport; a horse-drawn or machine-drawn sleigh is G1 (G-10).

name: Snowboard
definition: single wide board ridden sideways down snow with both feet bound to it.

name: Baseball bat
definition: rounded bat made for baseball or softball; hard-ball or soft-ball and material are attributes.

name: Baseball glove
definition: padded leather glove or mitt made for catching in baseball or softball.

name: Cricket ball
definition: hard, leather-covered cork-core ball with a raised seam, made for cricket.

name: Cricket bat
definition: flat-faced willow bat made for cricket; willow grade 1 to 4 is an attribute (a retailer convention).

name: Football
definition: inflated ball made for association football; size is an attribute.

name: Football boot
definition: studded or bladed boot made for football; the ground code (FG, AG, SG, MG, TF, IC) is an attribute.

name: Rugby ball
definition: oval inflated ball made for rugby; official-ball class and size are attributes.

name: Competition swimsuit
definition: racing suit made for competitive swimming; bikinis, trunks and beachwear are A1 (K-126).

name: Swim goggles
definition: watertight goggles made for swimming (K-125).

name: Wetsuit
definition: neoprene suit that insulates the wearer in water, for surfing, diving, triathlon and paddling; thickness is an attribute.

name: Diving mask
definition: mask with a glass lens and nose pocket made for diving and snorkelling.

name: Kitesurf kite
definition: large steerable kite made to pull a rider on a board across water.

name: Wing-foil wing
definition: hand-held inflatable wing that powers a rider on a foil board.

name: Bodyboard
definition: short foam board ridden lying prone on waves.

name: Stand-up paddleboard
definition: large board ridden standing and propelled with a paddle, rigid or inflatable.

name: Surfboard
definition: board ridden standing on breaking waves.

name: Knee pad
definition: padded guard worn over the knee to protect it in sport.

name: Mouthguard
definition: moulded guard worn over the teeth to protect them in contact sports.

name: Shin guard
definition: rigid or padded guard worn over the shin in sport.

name: Distress flare
definition: pyrotechnic flare that signals distress by light or smoke (K-84).

name: Flare pistol
definition: pistol made to fire distress or signal flares (K-84).

name: Gymnastic rings
definition: pair of rings hung on straps for gymnastic and bodyweight training.

name: Punch bag
definition: heavy hanging or free-standing bag struck in boxing and fitness training.

name: Skipping rope
definition: rope with handles turned and jumped over in training.

name: Crampon
definition: spiked frame fitted to a boot for grip on ice and hard snow.

name: Ice axe
definition: axe with a pick and adze made for climbing and travel on snow and ice.

name: Snowshoe
definition: wide frame strapped to a boot to walk on deep snow.

name: Golf bag
definition: bag that carries one set of golf clubs (K-137).

name: Ski bag
definition: bag that carries one pair of skis; a bag for several pieces is A4 (K-137).

name: Ski binding
definition: binding that fixes a boot to a ski or snowboard and releases it in a fall.

name: Table-tennis rubber
definition: rubber sheet, with or without sponge, glued to a table-tennis blade; surface (inverted, pimples-out, long pimples) is an attribute.

name: Racket case
definition: case or cover that holds one racket (K-137).

name: Tennis string
definition: string sold to string a tennis racket, by the set or the reel.
